description: Tenant-wide visibility (GA) into workspace networking / Outbound Access Protection (OAP) policies. Returns, per workspace, the inbound access protection (public-access default action + IP firewall rules) and outbound access protection (public access, cloud connection rules, gateway rules, Git policy, managed private endpoints). Admin-only (Tenant.Read.All). Read-only — for security auditing, compliance monitoring, and OAP-adoption reporting across the whole tenant.
notes: GA endpoint: GET /admin/workspaces/networking/communicationpolicies. Paginated (--all follows the continuation token). --filter supports only inbound/outbound publicAccessRules defaultAction eq 'deny' (optionally combined with 'or'); an unsupported property returns InvalidFilterExpression. defaultAction is Allow or Deny — Deny on outbound.publicAccessRules means Outbound Access Protection is enabled for that workspace. The table view surfaces INBOUND PUBLIC / OUTBOUND PUBLIC default actions; use --output json for the full firewall/connection/gateway/Git/managed-private-endpoint detail. Read-only: use the per-workspace fabio workspace get/set-*-policy and get/set-outbound-* commands to change a specific workspace's configuration.
